24 × 24 grid · 1.5 stroke · Web Components

Living Icons

Decoupled 3-layer architecture: Generic engine, motion verbs preset library, and declarative icon data rendered via <live-icon> elements.

Use a mouse, touch or the keyboard. The chips under each icon fire the same events if your device can't.

The dashed square in each stage is the 20-unit live area inside the 24-unit keyline. Everything is plain SVG, CSS and vanilla script. With reduced motion turned on, states still change but the movement is skipped.
